lines: Crowded market, eyes scan strangers passing by.
A kid clutches his mom’s hand, staring at a red balloon.
Cold coffee sits untouched, gaze locked on the empty chair.
A guitarist repeats the same song, nobody stops to listen.
A sheet of paper lands near the foot, hand lifts it.
People shuffle forward, heart feels stuck in place.
Wonder why all the noise can’t quiet the emptiness.
Being present means feeling the breath, not counting faces.
Notice the inhale, and the world finally lets you in.
Follow if this touched your heart.
